beats.summary: Oscar and Kevin argue about moving and pulling up the rug.

evidence.snippet: Oscar: Kevin, move. I can't pull up the rug if you're standing on it with your rhinoceros feet.
Kevin: Well I can't stand here if you pull the carpet out from under me.

beats.summary: Angela complains about her headache and Nellie suggests more coffee.

evidence.snippet: Angela: Oh, my head is killing me. Does anyone have a baby asprin?
Nellie: Oh, enough with the whining already! Why don't you just have some more coffee?

beats.summary: Stanley mentions his coffee was poured into a plant by Creed.

evidence.snippet: Stanley: It's all gone. I didn't get a chance to try them all because Creed poured my Bogota Sunrise in the plant.
Creed: I saw the leaves twitch!

beats.summary: Everyone leaves the office, causing a traffic backup.

evidence.snippet: [STAGE] everyone leaves and a traffic backup occurs in the parking lot

beats.summary: Dwight and Clark celebrate their success with high fives after opening the suit store.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Each one is very different, like a snowflake.
